bollymeter.basis: 80% on Rotten Tomatoes from 5 critics and a 95% audience score. Critics found the plot contrived but Kim Ok-vin's performance noted as a standout. Lightweight, watchable romantic comedy elevated by its lead.

pull_quotes.text: The plot is definitely contrived, but the story and the performance of Kim Ok-vin makes the series very watchable.

seasons.review_body: Love to Hate You dropped on Netflix in February 2023 as a breezy 10-episode romantic comedy built around an enemies-to-lovers pairing between a feminist entertainment lawyer and a movie star who distrusts women. The premise is deliberately familiar - the show wears its genre codes cheerfully rather than subverting them - and most of the five critics who reviewed it at Rotten Tomatoes acknowledged as much, landing on 80% fresh. The 95% audience score reflects warm reception from viewers seeking undemanding comfort romance. Kim Ok-vin as the attorney So-yeon drew specific praise for injecting wit and physicality into a role that could easily have been stock. Her co-lead Yoo In-su is more variable. The series runs a tight 10 episodes, which prevents it from overstaying its welcome; the finale delivers expected genre satisfactions without pretending to be anything else.

episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere efficiently deploys its premise: lawyer and movie star antagonism is established quickly, the tone is light and assured, and Kim Ok-vin's charisma communicates everything the script needs to set up.
episode_reviews.the_moment: So-yeon's blunt courtroom-style takedown of her new celebrity client signals the dynamic the whole show will run on.
